request.style: English, intimate piano ballad, tender female vocal, solo piano, cello, soft string pad, longing and hopeful, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I remember Sunday mornings and the singing in the hall
How I walked among the people and I felt you over all
Now the house is very quiet and the nights are very long
And I search for you in silence where I used to find a song

[Chorus]
As a deer longs for streams of water
So my soul longs for you, O God
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God
When shall I come and appear before God's face

[Verse]
My tears have been my food day and night
And still the voices ask me where you are
I pour my heart out on the kitchen floor
I hold on to the memory of the light

[Chorus]
As a deer longs for streams of water
So my soul longs for you, O God
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God
When shall I come and appear before God's face

[Bridge]
Why are you cast down, my soul
And why do you groan within me
Hope in God, for I will praise him again

[Outro]
As a deer longs for streams of water
So my soul longs for you, O God
